subject: OmniRetail trial: mutual action plan, success criteria & model stack
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Lucia Gomez <lucia.gomez@omniretail.com>, OmniRetail Pilot Team <partners@omniretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OmniRetail trial: mutual action plan, success criteria & model stack

Hi Lucia / OmniRetail team —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) so we can scope the 6-week trial and get procurement rolling.

Proposed trial scope (6 weeks)
- Workloads: conversational customer support (chat), product Q&A (search/FAQ)
- Languages: English + Spanish (priority), French for spot-checks (L2)
- Target platform: Redwood Hosted (fastest onramp) with option to move to Dedicated or Private after acceptance

Model stack (recommended)
- Primary: Llama-3-70B-instruct (quantized 4-bit) — balances instruction quality + multi-turn context for chat
- Fallback: Mistral-Instruct-7B (lighter, cheaper) for low-latency routing and degraded capacity scenarios
- Localization: apply locale-specific tokenizers and sample-based prompt templates; evaluate translation quality for Spanish set

Success criteria (acceptance) — must meet at end of trial:
- Functional: intent classification accuracy >= 88% on evaluation test set (defined below)
- Quality: hallucination rate <= 3% (manual review on random 500 responses)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 300 ms for short queries (<= 128 tokens)
- Cost: average cost per 1k tokens <= benchmark in SOW (will refine after dataset sizing)
- Reliability: sustained 99.5% endpoint availability during test windows

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (prep): share anonymized sample dataset (you); Redwood provides eval template (attached)
- Week 1: baseline runs (primary + fallback), collect metrics + failure modes
- Weeks 2–4: optimization (quantization tweaks, batching), weekly syncs; guardrail tuning for hallucinations
- Weeks 5–6: acceptance testing, joint review, runbook for go-live or handoff

Ownership
- Redwood PM (on trial): Tessa Morgan — overall delivery and PO coordination
- Redwood ML lead: Karthik Iyer — model config, quantization, routing policies
- Customer lead (OmniRetail): Lucia Gomez — data, acceptance sign-off, procurement contact
- CS onboarding: Laura Bennett — onboarding playbook and weekly ops syncs

Attachments: OmniRetail_trial_draft_SOW_20261129.pdf, evaluation_template_omniretail.xlsx

Immediate asks
1) Can you confirm sample dataset delivery timeline (we requested an anonymized 2k message sample)?
2) Any procurement quirks (PO process or vendor forms) that will impact a Dec kick-off?
3) Are there any specific data residency or SOC 2 controls we should include in the SOW?

If that looks good I can turn the MAP into a short SOW and send over next steps for signatures + kickoff date options (we suggested week of Dec 7).

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0147 | tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

From: Lucia Gomez <lucia.gomez@omniretail.com>

Subject: Re: OmniRetail trial: mutual action plan, success criteria & model stack

Tessa — thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Dataset: we can deliver the anonymized 2k sample by Thu (Dec 3). We'll include English + Spanish core tickets and mark language per row.
2) Timeline: procurement is fairly standard but our Legal will need a 2–3 business day review on the SOW. PO lead is Maria Ortega (cc'ed).
3) Deployment model question: is Redwood recommending Hosted for the full trial? We prefer Hosted for speed but need clarification on how data is handled and retention during the pilot. Can you add the retention window in the SOW?
4) Fallback model: curious whether Redwood can auto-failover to Mistral-Instruct-7B without impacting conversation context too much. If not, what's the expected UX difference?

Also looping in our InfoSec (sec@omniretail.com) to flag any SOC 2 evidence needs early.

If you can send the SOW + brief data retention bullets today we'll route to Legal and try to lock a Dec 7 kickoff.

— Lucia

Subject: Re: OmniRetail trial: mutual action plan, success criteria & model stack

Thanks — adding a few technical/ops items so the SOW has concrete knobs the PoC team can act on.

Model and infra notes
- Quantization: we'll test 4-bit Q4_0 for Llama-3-70B; expect ~3–4x reduction in GPU memory with modest quality tradeoffs. If quality drop too steep on Spanish, we'll fallback to Q5 or full 16-bit for the Spanish slice.
- Batching & latency: enable continuous batching with per-customer routing to keep p50 low. Typical config for chat load (~20 RPS) should meet your 300ms p95 target with Llama-3-70B quantized on A100-class nodes.
- KV cache & context: we'll persist KV cache per conversation for the trial; fallback model will receive a condensed context (last 2 user turns + system prompt) to minimize drift. UX impact: some loss of long-tail context but stable turn-level coherence tested in previous pilots.
- Fallback routing policy: prefer same-region hosted fallback, warm routes for Mistral-Instruct-7B; Redwood will auto-route on OOM or sustained latency >500ms for 10s window.

Evaluation metrics (brief)
- Intent accuracy: exact-match + fuzzy-match on taxonomies you provide
- Hallucination: measured via a 500-sample manual audit; define __hallucination__ in shared rubric (I attached a short checklist in the drive link)
- Localization: BLEU + human acceptability score for Spanish responses (>= 85% acceptability)

Operational owners and runbook
- Tessa: PM & procurement owner (kickoff scheduling)
- Karthik: ML config & rollout (model + fallback rules)
- Laura: CS & acceptance testing lead (collect NPS-style feedback)

Next steps I can action this week:
- Produce three model config variants (conservative, balanced, aggressive) and share perf/cost estimates by Wed (Dec 2)
- Draft failover runbook and rollback playbook for your SRE input by end of week

Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/sales/omniretail/PoC-MAP-20261129 (config notes live)

--

Looking forward to kicking this off.

— Lucia
